fallback.sample_centers_per_wfg_level0_tile_check: 60 x 60 for global corner and antimeridian/equatorial probes

preferred_30m.public_mirror: GLO-30 Public is partial and is not used by this resolver

proof.gebco_extent: GEBCO_2026 is the global 15 arc-second latitude/longitude grid spanning all WGS84 coordinates; level-0 tile corner and wrap checks resolve 60 x 60 cell centers.
proof.logical_grid_partition: WFG-1 level 0 partitions [-180,180) x [-90,90] into exactly 1440 x 720 half-open cells; global poles are assigned by specified edge rules.
proof.per_tile_resolution: Every WFG-1 level-0 address maps to a catalogued COP-DEM-GLO-90-F COG or is explicitly assigned to GEBCO_2026 fallback. The GLO-90 inventory is a source availability index, not a land mask; fallback tiles are not described as ocean unless the GEBCO TID mask identifies them.

route_map.algorithm: row-major WFG-1 level-0 address ID to GLO-90 catalog prefix or explicit GEBCO fallback
